goal: Why weren't all eligible conversations evaluated?

visibleEvidence.selection:
Policy selection

500 eligible interactions were not selected by the sampling policy.

The sampling policy selected 500 of 1,000 eligible interactions (50%).

Sampling can deliberately select only part of the eligible population.

100 sampled interactions had no usable conversation content.

Failed evaluation attempts are attempts, not interaction counts. One interaction can have more than one form evaluation attempt.

answer: 500 were not selected by the sampling policy
